title: Review Result Primitive
description: Structured output from a brilliance code review. Each finding is a typed entry with dimension, severity, location, and a concrete fix diff.

dimension.description: Which review dimension this finding relates to.

severity.description: critical: data corruption/security/crash. high: swallowed errors/race/leaks. medium: misleading names/missing edge cases. low: style nits. praise: positive reinforcement.

issue.description: One-sentence description of the problem. Empty string if severity is praise.

fix.description: Concrete diff or code suggestion. For praise, describe what's good.

verdict.description: One-paragraph summary. If zero non-praise findings: 'Ship it. 🚢'

praiseCount.description: Number of findings with severity=praise. Must be >= 1. Positive reinforcement is mandatory.

outputRules.noUnactionableFeedback: Every non-praise finding must include a concrete fix. No 'this could be better' without showing how.
outputRules.praiseIsMandatory: At least one praise finding per review. Tell them what's already good.
outputRules.severityOrder: Critical/high first, then medium, then low, then praise.
